name: room
text: Room opened — goal: watch: Analyze video AUDIO+VISUAL (Gemini) for content beyond the transcript.

name: Scope
text: To achieve our goal of analyzing the Gemini video for content beyond the transcript, I recommend that we start by watching the video with the audio and visuals together, rather than separating them. This approach will allow us to pick up on non-verbal cues, tone, and context that may not be evident in the transcript alone. By doing so, we're accepting the trade-off of potentially slower analysis, but it's worth it for the deeper understanding we'll gain of the video's content. This holistic approach will give us a more well-rounded view of the video's message and allow us to identify nuances that might otherwise be missed.

name: Frame
text: Frame: That’s a weak play—watching the video whole risks missing critical details buried in one channel but not the other. Better to split the work: one tracks audio for tone and gaps, another scans visuals for context the transcript misses. Settle it by running both in parallel for 10 minutes, then compare findings—if one channel dominates, we adjust.
